text_blocks.snippet: Jardiance (empagliflozin) is a prescription medication that works by helping your kidneys remove extra sugar through your urine. Because of how it changes fluid and sugar balance, it can cause several common and serious side effects.
You can review complete safety details through the Jardiance Official Safety Guide.

list.snippet: Increased Urination: Needing to pee more often or in larger amounts as the body flushes out excess glucose.
Urinary Tract Infections (UTIs): Symptoms include a burning sensation during urination, frequent urgency, cloudy or bloody urine, and lower back or pelvic pain.
Genital Yeast Infections: More common in women (vaginal itching, burning, and thick white discharge), though men can also develop yeast infections around the penis or scrotum.
Dehydration and Dizziness: Feeling lightheaded, dizzy, or weak—especially when standing up—due to fluid and salt loss.

text_blocks.snippet: Serious Side Effects (Seek Immediate Medical Care)

list.snippet: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid in the blood that can happen even if blood sugar levels are not very high. Warning signs include nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, unusual fatigue, trouble breathing, and a fruity odor on your breath.

Necrotizing Fasciitis (Fournier's Gangrene): A rare but life-threatening bacterial infection of the tissue under the skin in the perineum (area between the genitals and the anus) causing severe pain, swelling, redness, and fever.
Severe Kidney Injury or Infections: Sudden worsening of kidney function or serious kidney infections (pyelonephritis).
Low Blood Sugar (Hypoglycemia): More likely if Jardiance is taken alongside other diabetes medications like insulin or sulfonylureas.
Lower Limb Amputations: An increased risk reported with SGLT2 inhibitors, particularly for people with a history of prior amputations, foot ulcers, or severe peripheral vascular disease.
Serious Allergic Reactions: Hives or swelling of the face, lips, tongue, and throat causing difficulty swallowing or breathing.
